name: komo-apps
description: JS/TS clients for komo — a shared React renderer (app) mounted by an Electron desktop shell (desktop) and a standalone web build (web), all talking to the gateway's HTTP api channel.

scripts.build: bun run --filter='komo-web' build && bun run --filter='komo-desktop' build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run test
